notes.title: Astral Blaze pricing update
notes.content: This is an announcement that Astral Blaze will transition to being a Free-to-play game in the following weeks. This was decided to make the game accessible to more players. Special thanks to everyone that supported the game by buying it up to now.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content: -improved worlmap walking input. Now you can change direction while walking without releasing walk buttons.
